obtainable.name: Seven-Eyed Mask
obtainable.location: Talk to the Masks here for an event, where you'll receive the Seven-Eyed Mask. (step 5)

enemies.name: Atman
enemies.notes: Uses SP Lowering, and inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies

steps.description:
1. Head into **Roger**'s house and talk to him, and he'll have you rest up while he works on the teleporter.
2. In the meantime, you'll regain control of **Alice** in **Yuri**'s **Graveyard**.
3. Read the tombstones if you like, then go talk to the **Masks**.
4. They'll make you go through the doors to the evil dimension to meet **Atman**, the god of death.
5. One of two things here will now happen:

notes.title: Note
notes.text: This is your **last opportunity** to decide which ending you get, if you haven't already! See **[W-S-15] The Good Ending (Defeating the Masks)** for details on getting the good ending!

notes.title: Note
notes.text: Make sure to have **Crucifixes** equipped on **Alice** and **Yuri**, as the next boss can cause pretty much every status abnormality.

steps.description:
- 1) **Alice** will enter a battle with **Atman**, alone.
- This is what will happen if you chose the follow the path to the bad ending.
- You cannot defeat **Atman**, and after a few turns, he'll cast Eradication and defeat **Alice** in battle, at which point you'll wake back up and regain control in **Roger**'s house.
2) **Yuri** will come in, and he and **Alice** both will battle **Atman**. Here we go...

items.text: **Atman** can still kill **Alice** in two rounds, so make sure that she stays healed.
As for attacks, this time around, **Atman** will still use Eradication, but it won't kill; instead, it'll just do a pretty good amount of damage, as well as reduce SP.
He can also attack normally, as well as use **Dragon Cry** and other strong class spells for decent damage.
Have **Yuri** fuse into **Amon** and rip into **Atman** with physical attacks, while **Alice** should be using **Arc** every round to keep their HP maxed.
If for some reason she gets a free turn, have her cast **Advent** to help **Yuri** deal some damage.

steps.description: After the battle, watch the quick scene (and cut-scene, if you defeated **Atman**), then you'll regain control.

- If you defeated **Atman** with both **Yuri** and **Alice**, there's one more item we can grab.
- Before talking to **Roger**, head back out onto the **World Map** and choose to go into the **Graveyard**.
- Talk to the Masks here for an event, where you'll receive the **Seven-Eyed Mask**.
- Also, to confirm that you are getting the good ending, read the small tombstone beside the **Dark Gravestone**; it should now say "**Atman**, rest in peace..."

1. Back in the **Nemeton Monastery**, talk to **Roger**.
2. (You may have a sequence involving the **Erotic Book** and **Pulse Tract** first before the story moves on; see **[W-S-16] Nemeton Monastery (The Seraphic Radiance / Yuri's Weapon & Armor / Lottery Member #0)** below for the full details.)
3. He'll be finished, and asks you if you wish to go to **Neameeto**.
4. (If you choose 1, you may see that **Roger** is **Lottery Member** No. 00; see **[W-S-16] Nemeton Monastery (The Seraphic Radiance / Yuri's Weapon & Armor / Lottery Member #0)** below for the full details.)
5. When you're ready, choose 2 and you'll have to complete a **Spin Ring** 5 (that's right, 15 targets) to have **Roger** successfully send you off!

choices.option: 1. Wait, I need to use the bathroom!

steps.description:
**Neameeto**
- You've made it!
- However, now that we've completed the **Atman** sequence and stepped foot on **Neameeto**, we can take on the very last bit of side quests.
- If you don't want to do it, skip down to **[W-2-16] Final Preparations**.
- Otherwise, step on the yellow circle in this room to be sent back down to the **Nemeton Monastery**!
